## Implementation Complete

I've successfully implemented a bulk delete endpoint for items. Here's what was done:

### Changes Made

**1. Added ItemDelete Model** (`backend/app/models.py`)
- New request model that accepts a list of item IDs

**2. Implemented POST /items/delete/bulk Endpoint** (`backend/app/api/routes/items.py`)
- Accepts a JSON payload with a list of item IDs
- Validates that IDs are provided (400 if empty)
- Fetches all items matching the IDs (404 if none found)
- Enforces ownership: users can only delete their own items; superusers can delete any items
- Deletes all items in a single transaction
- Returns success message with count of deleted items

**3. Comprehensive Test Coverage** (`backend/tests/api/routes/test_items.py`)
- ✓ Successful bulk delete as superuser
- ✓ Empty ID list rejection
- ✓ Non-existent items handling
- ✓ Permission validation (rejects normal users deleting others' items)
- ✓ Normal user can delete their own items

### Test Results
All 16 tests pass, including the 5 new tests for bulk delete functionality.
